## About this blog

I am Aravind Hebbali. I build and maintain R packages at
[Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/) and use this blog to
announce releases, document design decisions, and write about R, economics
and data science.

Earlier tutorials from 2016 to 2020 now live at
[blog.rsquaredacademy.com](https://blog.rsquaredacademy.com/), so links to
them keep working.
